concepts.label: backhaul-link
concepts.gloss: A transport link that connects a site gateway to the core network and serves one or more radio cells.

concepts.label: site-gateway
concepts.gloss: A demarcation device at a site that acts as the gateway for local cells and links to the backhaul.

concepts.label: backhaul-marking
concepts.gloss: A DSCP-based QoS marking applied on the backhaul to classify traffic for differentiated handling.

concepts.label: backhaul-capacity
concepts.gloss: The committed data rate capacity of the backhaul link.

concepts.label: backhaul-mtu
concepts.gloss: The maximum transmission unit for frames on the backhaul link.

concepts.label: radio-cell
concepts.gloss: A radio cell (sector) in the wireless network that is served by the backhaul.

concepts.label: rrc-session
concepts.gloss: A radio resource control (RRC) session or state associated with a radio cell.

concepts.label: beacon-tag-7
concepts.gloss: An opaque, vendor-specific attribute attached to the backhaul for proprietary configuration.
